completion_scope.included: One continuous first-run dated 6/2–10/26 calendar in six chronological sections, day/night, all 14 Followers R8, 50 identified Golden Beetle positions (46 required for all beetle rewards), all seven book-reading commitments, eight dated candidate debates, short-expiry requests and report deadlines, major side-quest/dungeon travel paths, trophies/cooking/arena, Royal Virtue gates and final free-action checklist. Separate NG+ optional appendix for exclusive redscale superboss.
completion_scope.excluded: NG+ redscale boss from first-run contract; appendix handles it. Repetitive grinding, arbitrary loot RNG, optional item-perfect inventory and mutually exclusive outcome permutations are not mandated.
completion_scope.progress: Author expansion in-progress after owner scope comment PR #120/6956649441. 6 sequential date-grouped JSON sections and an NG+ appendix authored; needs independent date-by-date content/source verification, stricter day/night collision audit, and fresh structural+accuracy reviews. Do not interpret presence of a dated step as verified 100% feasibility.

disagreements: A labels several Rank 8 entries as RANK4; B+E agree these are rank 8. A implies Maria paintings are mandatory; B+E describe Maria's rank-ups through conversations and Virtue ranks; scenic paintings should be treated as optional gifts. A and E map some Neuras relics to different rank indices: E confirms any of the six relics may be turned in out of order for ranks 2–7, so the guide lists locations without a forced hand-in order. Some earliest-day indications in A conflict with B's 2-day spacing; B and E are used for cadence and quest prerequisites. Character sections are chronological windows, not fixed appointment dates. English localized and Japanese quest names are linked where directly verified. Accuracy review A1 (2026-11-17): GameWith's Catherina R2 condition explicitly specifies outgoing travel from Martira to Great Sandworm's Nest; Gamecap only confirms the battle after July 2, so corrected the previously incorrect incoming-leg assertion. A2: Gamecap's Junah prerequisite 枯れ薬の材料を探せ is corroborated by GameWith's dedicated quest page and independent Japanese quest guides (Kamigame and Chucco); added the preceding request to the executable chain. GameWith's summary follower table omitted the prerequisite, but its quest-specific page states it. SCOPE UPDATE 2026-11-17: Owner explicitly requested a Persona-style spoiler-light day-by-day first-run calendar in PR #120 issuecomment-6956649441. The 2024 independent JP schedules (アルテマ, ゲーマーの備忘録) choose different dungeon dates and day/night activities but share a feasible first-run max-Follower/content goal; GameWith provides another 2026-maintained monthly calendar. Different recommendations are swappable, never presented as hard quest windows without corroboration. A date-specific bond plan from the original GamerB schedule must be checked against actual rank prerequisites, calendar-time costs and early dungeon state. PowerPyx and RPG Site independently confirm most first-run content is doable with only the NG+ superboss beyond the first playthrough. This expanded new content invalidates both structural and accuracy PASS for all modified sections; keep reviewed:false. ADDITIONAL 2026-11-17 missables research: Japanese Game8/GameWith and detailed GAMEX, plus independent English PowerPyx, corroborate 50 Gold Beetles, 46 needed for all exchanges. Older Gamecap and some older sites say 49, but 50 is the newer verified inventory; verify actual target platform. Three potentially lost beetles: 6/5 camp, quest-report reward by 8/9, 9/24 one-day Eldan visit. Gamex/independent quest source distinguishes quest ACCEPT vs REPORT deadlines: medicine 6/16, inn 6/19, pigeon eggs 7/11, toothbrush 8/9, flower 8/10, puppet materials 8/30. GameWith quest directory says pigeon egg quest is accepted at Martira street square; correct old preliminary Grand Trad assumption. Book 『魔法的未来』 must be acquired from Julian 7/23–8/12, even if reading later; Maria+Fabienne special inn help must occur Maria R2+ and BEFORE 9/26. Japanese GamerB calendar shows daytime Brilehaven debates 7/23/24, while Gamex generic explanation says debates are night: document as source conflict not a hard universal night-time requirement; player should follow current map/podium and authoritative calendar slot if offered. Time-free beetle pickups should not consume a separate day/night slot. This is an author content update, not a source-independent 100% PASS.
